description: This file defines the AjaxResponse class, which implements JSONAware to generate JSON responses for AJAX calls, including status, data, validation messages, and error handling.

classes.name: AjaxResponse
classes.description: A class representing an AJAX response, capable of serializing its data to JSON, including status, data entries, validation messages, and error messages.

methods.name: getValidationMessages
methods.description: Returns the map of validation messages.

methods.name: addDataEntry
methods.description: Adds a data entry (map) to the response data list.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the data map.

methods.name: setErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets the status message based on a Throwable's message.

methods.name: setErrorString
methods.description: Sets the status message directly from a string.

methods.name: addValidationMessage
methods.description: Adds a validation message for a specific field.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the response object to a JSON string.
